address: 7-9 Paddington Street, Marylebone, London, W1U 5QH, United Kingdom
bio: Cooking with fire is all the rage these days and Lita, which opened in 2024, is another expert practitioner, although it also offers so much more. While there’s a strong Mediterranean and southern European element to the menu, prime British ingredients – such as Scottish langoustines and Norfolk quail – along with big, bold flavours and well-made sauces really make the dishes sing. Many of the plates are designed for sharing, like succulent Cornish lamb with smoked aubergine and sheep’s milk. This is roll-up-your-sleeves sort of food – the type that leaves you licking your lips and planning your return....
